description: World Ecophysiographic Data is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Living Atlas – Landscape Content . Ecological Land Units (ELUs) are areas of distinct bioclimate, landform, lithology, and land cover that form the basic components of terrestrial ecosystem structure. This analysis service is meant to support suitability modeling in GeoPlanner for ArcGIS. The service has 18 world-wide ecophysiographic layers that can be used for ecological modeling and impact assessment. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Living Atlas – Landscape Content . Its keywords are weightedOverlayService. The bounding box given is -180.0000,-60.0006,180.0000,89.0000. The hub shows 2023-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
